notes: TFP410 has multiple analog risk areas — TFADJ-controlled current driver, 10× PLL, differential clock crossover detector, low-swing input comparator. Lab characterization on every new board is recommended. Compliance test suites: DVI Compliance Test Specification (DDWG) and HDMI Compliance Test Specification (HDMI LLC) provide the formal test programmes.
ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)

calibration_categories.name: Pixel-rate sweep + PLL lock check
calibration_categories.purpose: f_IDCK = 25 to 165 MHz; PLL lock + lock-time.

calibration_categories.name: Eye diagram on TMDS pairs
calibration_categories.purpose: Eye height ≥ 400 mV diff; width ≥ 0.5 UI; jitter ≤ 150 ps.

calibration_categories.name: Input setup/hold margin
calibration_categories.purpose: Sweep DATA arrival relative to IDCK.

calibration_categories.name: ESD test
calibration_categories.purpose: DVI pins ±4 kV HBM; others ±2 kV.
